article.headline: Rainey Welson leads with 17 points and No. 19 Maryland women roll past Columbia 85-58
article.description: — Rainey Welson scored a career-high 17 points off the bench to lead five players in double figures and No. 19 Maryland rode a dominating first half to an 85-58 victory over Columbia on Sunday.
article.linkText: Rainey Welson leads with 17 points and No. 19 Maryland women roll past Columbia 85-58
article.story: COLLEGE PARK, Md. -- — Rainey Welson scored a career-high 17 points off the bench to lead five players in double figures and No. 19 Maryland rode a dominating first half to an 85-58 victory over Columbia on Sunday. Welson, a sophomore, made 5 of 8 3-pointers and both of her free throw attempts. Addi Mack scored 14 points and Bri McDaniel, Nunu Agara and Jordyn Jackson all scored 10 for the Terrapins (2-1). The Terrapins shot 48% overall, making 10 of 17 3-pointers (59%) and 19 of 21 free throws (91%). They had 16 assists and scored 29 points following 23 Columbia turnovers. Riley Weiss scored 13 points and Hilke Feldrappe 10 for the Lions (3-2). Maryland scored the first 11 and the last nine points of the first quarter, building a 20-5 lead. The Terrapins forced eight turnovers, leading to 13 points. A 13-0 run in the second quarter helped Maryland take a 41-14 lead at halftime. Columbia fared better in the second half while Maryland's reserves got more playing time. The Terps had a 22-21 advantage in the third quarter and Columbia had the edge in the fourth, 23-22. Up next Columbia hosts No. 5 Duke on Saturday.
